title: Giving Up Places on a Vacation Package and Setting the Booking to the Party Travelling
content:
Where a party on one of the Vacation Package Products gives up places, the booking is set to the party that is actually travelling and to the price the package then carries. Giving up places on a package is the party's own act on their own booking, confirmed by the lead traveller.

## Basis

The price the package carries for the party actually travelling is fixed only after the ledger carries an amendment charge posted since the operations desk approved the change to the travelling party.

Until such a charge stands on the ledger, posted since the operations desk approved the change to the travelling party, the price the package carries for the party actually travelling is not fixed.

## What the act does

One act rewrites the named package's record to show the adults and the children who remain and the price the package now carries for them, quoting the operations desk request the change answers. Afterwards the booking shows the smaller party and the new price, and everything the operator does for the rest of the holiday is done for that party; nothing else on the booking moves.

## How it is done

The tool `confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75` belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## What must be given

| Given | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_package_id` | the internal reference number of the vacation package the places are given up on, read from the package record returned by the package lookup | an identifier |
| `bundle_request_id` | the reference number of the change request the operations desk has recorded for this package, read from the change request lookup | an identifier |
| `remaining_adults` | how many adults are still travelling once the places are given up | a whole number of adults, at least 1, counted as heads and not as fares |
| `remaining_children` | how many children are still travelling once the places are given up | a whole number of children, zero or more, counted as heads and not as fares |
| `revised_package_price_usd` | the price the package carries for the party now travelling | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the nearest cent, and never negative |

## What comes back

A one-line receipt string. It contains the package reference number, the adults and children now shown on the booking, and the price the package now carries in US dollars to two decimal places. A string of this shape means the booking has been rewritten; any other outcome means the party and the price are unchanged.
